Every emitted event carries maxStacks===5 and observed stacks ∈ [1,5]. Fails under maxStacks omitted, set to 1, or uncapped. (targetMaxHpPct re-emits flat as 'maxHpFlat', so the raw 3.04 is not assertable.)
No maxHpFlat buff cast by rumani ever lands on a non-rumani targetSlug. Fails under a widened `allies` target set.
Stripping skill1 leaves every unit's total byte-identical — rumani has no atkOfMaxHpPct consumer. Fails if Max HP were mis-encoded as atkPct/atkOfMaxHpPct/attackDamagePct.
it.skip — no taunt/aggro primitive in EffectDef and no boss targeting model.
Zero partsDamagePct buffApply events in the baseline. Fails under the nearest-wrong encoding hitCount:5 (a generic every-5-hits trigger), which would fire ~20x/fight on a partless boss.
Stripping skill2 moves no unit — payload is parsed-but-inert in v1. Fails if the line were encoded as a generic ally damage buff.

Re-keying every burst block to fullBurstEnter changes the board (≥ baseline). Proves the shipped blocks are gated on rumani's own burst cast — critical because she is a Burst I competing with liter for the stage-1 slot, so fullBurstEnter would over-credit on rotations she never casts.

buffApply stat==='normalAttackPct', value 10.05, distinct targetSlugs === 4 and includes rumani ('all allies' includes self). Fails under attackDamagePct (generic Damage Up — would also lift skill/burst damage), and under self-only / excludeSelf targeting. Backed by a magnitude check: the attackDamagePct swap yields a different board total.
With all burst blocks exercised (trigger-patched), dropping this line plus the Damage-Taken line leaves totals identical — inert. Fails if encoded as an ATK-flavoured stat.
Same inertness assertion — fails if encoded as the boss debuff damageTakenPct (positive = boss takes more), which would raise whole-team damage. Defensive self-buff with no HP pool at scope lock.

spec.kitLine: when Muscle Up at max stacks
spec.assertion: it.skip — no primitive gates a block on the owner's own buff stack count (resourceGate reads a declared resource pool, not a buff).

fixtures: controlComp('rumani', true) throughout — liter B1 / crown B2 / rumani / helm B3, Fire boss, focus rumani; deterministic, no seed. 7 hoisted runs: baseline; skill1 stripped; skill2 stripped; all burst blocks re-keyed to fullBurstEnter; that same patch keeping only the normalAttackPct block; keeping only the other two burst blocks; and the normalAttackPct→attackDamagePct stat swap. The burst-slot claims are read off the trigger-patched runs because rumani is a Burst I sharing the stage-1 slot with the control comp's liter — the fixture cannot guarantee she wins the cast, and the patch changes only the trigger, so stat/value/target-set observed there is still the shipped block's own encoding.
gaps: skill1 'Taunts for 5 sec' (Full Charge hit during Full Burst) — no taunt/aggro primitive; boss has no targeting model.
skill2 'Damage to Parts ▲ 10.05%' — partsDamagePct is parsed-but-inert in v1 (partless scope-lock boss); the parts-hit trigger is itself unreachable.
burst 'Damage Taken ▼ 20.06%' on self — purely defensive; no HP pool and the boss deals no damage at scope lock.
burst 'Activates when Muscle Up is at max stacks' — no own-buff-stack gate primitive (resourceGate reads a resource pool, not a buff's stack count).

FIXTURE GAP: rumani is Burst I and contends with controlComp's liter for the stage-1 cast, so the control comp cannot guarantee her own burst ever fires; burst-slot coverage is routed through trigger-patched counterfactuals instead.
